acquisition.external_dependency: source_tools/soil_sources.py from the current cumulative original soil component F0C8MNY5RN2

compatible_api.parcel_criteria_prepare: prepare(workspace, {'study_id': actual_id, 'sources': actual_role_choices}) or prepare(workspace, saved_operation_id)
compatible_api.source_context: Existing original parcel/reporting geometry-context binding is retained.
compatible_api.candidate_and_portfolio: Existing eligible, score, score_components, rank, selected_ids and selected_union contracts remain usable.
compatible_api.selected_models: Current selected NDR-only, SDR-only and combined model quantities remain on their maintained conservation path.

interval_method.geometry: lower = area(P intersection O); upper = lower + area(P outside (O union C)), capped at area(P)
interval_method.P: Bound original full parcel for parcel_acres; retained reporting-parcel intersection for hydric/riparian acreage.
interval_method.O: Unioned positively selected original source footprint.
interval_method.C: Actual selected certainty geometry, separate from an original query mask.
interval_method.riparian_partial_union: Keep any positively mapped constant-buffer or variable-riparian component as a subset of the published union.
interval_method.threshold_application: Evaluate endpoints and every published step inside the interval. Exact points follow if all attainable values receive the same contribution.

artifact_flow.canonical: criteria.json retains exact IDs, null unresolved acreage, intervals, evidence and original geometry binding.
artifact_flow.csv: Numeric <metric>_lower/<metric>_upper columns and full metric_bounds JSON.
artifact_flow.geopackage: Original and reporting parcel layers contain numeric endpoints and full interval descriptor.
artifact_flow.workspace_import: Entry scope retains numeric_intervals alongside study_id, geometry_context and coverage.

receiving.install: Decode the complete files, compile the Python sources before replacing their exact maintained predecessors, and preserve the existing current soil transport/overlay dependencies.
receiving.current_work: Run the actual retained original source operation, prepare its parcel criteria, then build the selected published-practice study through the existing Conservation operator.
return_artifacts: original acquisition operation/result and imported collection identities
actual criteria table, coverage and two-layer GeoPackage
saved point study and criterion intervals/points in candidate details
receiving.implementation_identity: Successor source bytes create a distinct preparation identity; completed prior studies remain retained and newly submitted requests use the successor.
